name: please-rest
description: PleaseREST — the Claude Code pipeline that turns a REST API reference into a working Grasshopper plugin for Rhino.

plugins.name: please-rest
plugins.description: Politely turns any REST API into a Grasshopper plugin — so you can take that much needed rest. Automates the repeatable parts: API mapping, call validation, codegen, icons, tests, and Food4Rhino publish. You plan, review, and test. PleaseREST does the rest.
